configuration.primary_business_metric: mean CV Fail coverage at floor(10% N) per edition per validation fold
configuration.cv: same five persisted student-group folds for all six candidates
baselines: reactive after closure, preventive coverage 0 and late capacity bounded

llm.context_source: only current training fold; balanced examples and full-fold empirical priors
llm.preparation: same train-fold-fitted median/one-hot/scaler; LLM receives names and sparse values of that same prepared matrix
llm.representation_precision: six significant digits, recorded as interface precision, not an additional learned transform
llm.reproduction: archive requests/responses privately and reproduce scores from cache; provider nondeterminism is not hidden
llm.safety: reserve a conservative cost bound before each call; ambiguous failures keep reservation, no automatic retries
llm.probability_output_precision: at most four decimal places in prompting
llm.cost_accounting: input base plus cache-write premiums, no cache-read discount; reserve highest 12h input rate by total JSON byte bound
llm.response_format: strict fixed objects probabilities.q000..q031 with named Approved, Fail, Withdrawn fields; exact query coverage and duplicate-key rejection
llm.integration_gate: all 1000 fixed training-metric rows of fold0 before freezing, no validation metrics used

tuning.criterion: best default candidate CV business coverage
tuning.budget_gate: do not silently omit required configs/folds when budget is insufficient

train_metric_sampling.selection: seeded stratified subset only of training-fold; explicitly labelled as sampled train metric

configuration.static_controls: independently tuned matched family, same search draws plus default as longitudinal final family

anticipation.models_to_evaluate: finalist families plus matched static and indicator ablation; include LLM if finalist
anticipation.budget: one shared initial capacity across rounds; no repeated enrollment; report unique students

holdout.claim: retrospective reused benchmark, not a newly untouched independent test
holdout.new_version_rule: freeze top2 and static controls by CV before a single final batch; no holdout tuning

configuration.git: commit source before definitive runs; source cleanliness is required; no invented historical SHA
configuration.old_version: preserve full private verified backup; original artifacts are not copied as v2 results
configuration.revision_reason: Incomplete repeated-array generation in attempt 2 before LLM validation; fixed named-query output fields and duplicate-key rejection. Preserve all attempts/costs and repeat every family in a fresh experiment.
